What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to have a few essential components in place. First, you need to choose a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which will serve as the foundation for your store. You also need to select a backend logic provider like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which will handle the payment processing and product delivery. Additionally, you need to set up a payment gateway like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and has a low fee of 0.5%.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack. You need to integrate your payment gateway with your backend logic provider, which will handle the payment processing and trigger the product delivery. You also need to configure your product storage and delivery system, which can be done using services like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With this pipeline in place, you can automatically deliver your digital products to buyers upon payment confirmation.
